sloka: तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।किञ्चास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्तु दिवौकसः ।। ७.३०.७ ॥
transliteration: tanmucyatāṁ mahābāho mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।kiñcāsya mokṣaṇārthāya prayacchantu divaukasaḥ ।। 7.30.7 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, let the great Indra, the slayer of Paka, be released, and let the gods also offer something for his liberation.
